title: Fulltech sees low DK2 shipments rising, starts M9 quartz cloth certification
content: Fulltech, a glass fiber yarn and cloth maker, said at its 2026 annual general meeting that demand for next-generation AI servers and high-speed switches is lifting specifications and demand for upstream PCB materials. Chairman Yuan-Pin Chang said the share of low DK2 shipments will keep rising in the second half of 2026, helping optimize the product mix and boost revenue and profitability.

title: Smartphone demand and chip supply pressures cloud 2H26 peak season outlook
content: Market sentiment toward the smartphone industry remains subdued. On the demand side, global smartphone sales have declined for several consecutive weeks during the second quarter of 2026, with only Apple and Huawei showing relative resilience thanks to their strong brand appeal. On the supply side, chip shortages continue to intensify, expanding beyond memory products to include both advanced-node and mature-node semiconductors.

title: Microsoft's Satya Nadella warns against AI profits being absorbed by just a few companies
content: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella warned against allowing only a handful of companies to economically profit from the new AI era. In an interview with Bloomberg, he critiqued the current trajectory of the AI race while predicting that the next phase of the industry would rely more on cheaper models.

title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics rides Qualcomm's data center push into servers
content: Samsung Electro-Mechanics has begun mass production of advanced package substrates for Qualcomm's first data center AI accelerator, extending the companies' supply relationship from mobile and PC chips into server-class semiconductors, ZDNet Korea reported.
